title: Nitric oxide-releasing PHEMA/polysilsesquioxane photocrosslinked hybrids
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,45048-45060
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07870A, Paper

Herllan Vieira de Almeida, Laura Caetano Escobar da Silva, Bruno de Almeida Piscelli, Beatriz Rafaelle Goes dos Santos, Daniele Mendes Guizoni, Ana Paula Davel, Rodrigo Antonio Cormanich, Marcelo Ganzarolli de Oliveira
PHEMA/PSS hybrids loaded with GSNO or SNAP release NO upon hydration. Their distinct real-time NO release profiles reflect different matrix interactions, highlighting their potential use as tunable platforms for controlled NO delivery.
